 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**meet**" means to come into the presence or company of someone by chance or arrangement. (मिलना)

 
 
• Example: She traveled extensively to **meet** new people and explore different cultures.
 
 
 
• **Meet** is used here to convey the activity of encountering new people during travels or trips. (मिलना)
 
 
• Example: He enjoys traveling because he gets the opportunity to **meet** interesting individuals from around the globe.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

**Complete Sentence:** We all travel for different reasons: wanderlust, a want to experience a different culture, a desire to forget, or a desire to **meet**__ new people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Greet (अभिवादन करना)**: To give a polite word or sign of welcome or recognition to someone on meeting. 

 
 
• Example: She hurried to greet her guests at the door.
 
 
 
• **Reflect (प्रतिबिंबित करना)**: To think deeply or carefully about something. 
 
 
• Example: He started to reflect on his own life after witnessing the struggles of others.
 
 
 
• **Hold (पकड़ना)**: To grasp, carry, or support with one's hands. 
 
 
• Example: Please hold the handle firmly while walking up the stairs.
